quizzes.question_text: Put these numbers in order from greatest to least.
solution: To put integers in order, picture them on a number line. $\\[1em]$ Negative numbers sit to the left of $0$ and positive numbers sit to the right. For two negative numbers, the one with the bigger absolute value is actually smaller (it sits farther to the left). $\\[1em]$ The three numbers we need to order are $-24, 18, -19$.
Place each value on the number line from smallest (far left) to largest (far right): $\\[1em]$ $-24, -19, 18$. $\\[1em]$ Then read them off in the direction the question asks (least to greatest).
Final order (least to greatest): $\\[1em]$ $-24 < -19 < 18$.

solution: To put integers in order, picture them on a number line. $\\[1em]$ Negative numbers sit to the left of $0$ and positive numbers sit to the right. For two negative numbers, the one with the bigger absolute value is actually smaller (it sits farther to the left). $\\[1em]$ The three numbers we need to order are $91, -53, 79$.
Place each value on the number line from smallest (far left) to largest (far right): $\\[1em]$ $-53, 79, 91$. $\\[1em]$ Then read them off in the direction the question asks (least to greatest).
Final order (least to greatest): $\\[1em]$ $-53 < 79 < 91$.
